body.title: bug: The default value of a `case` expression is not properly serialized
body.body:
### Can you reproduce the bug on the Forgejo test instance?

No

### Description

If a case expression `${{ case(cond, then, default) }}` is evaluated with a falsy condition `cond`, then the value of `default` is not properly serialized if it's not a string: in my case `default` was a number (namely the context value `forge.event.pull_request.number`), which got serialized as `"<float64-value>"`.

As a workaround one can use `format('{0}', default)`.

I believe the fix is replacing `defaultValue.String()` with `impl.coerceToString(defaultValue).String()`, but I haven't tried to get the runner working locally
 https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/commit/c4a92ffa5e3a400ae7e9c40a2914e649eb338ad7/act/exprparser/functions.go#L331

### Forgejo Version

_No response_

### Runner Version

v13.2.0

### How are you running Forgejo?

I'm using the Codeberg instance.

### How are you running the Runner?

Systemd service through NixOS@[`c59305bab2065cfecc4944690d9eedbb56f3a9fa`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/tree/c59305bab2065cfecc4944690d9eedbb56f3a9fa)

### Logs

_No response_

### Workflow file

```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        type: number

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: 'nix'
    container:
      image: 'ghcr.io/catthehacker/ubuntu:act-24.04'
    steps:
      - if: >-
          ${{ forge.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
              forge.event_name == 'pull_request_target' ||
              forge.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
        run: |
          echo "p/${{ case(forge.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch', inputs.pr_number, forge.event.pull_request.number) }}"
```
